definition: The rule was tested against this house and the house meets it. A pass is always a measurement: a rule that could not be tested is never shown as passed.
basis: VISION.md section VII, the commitment every verdict on the workbench keeps: "Every check distinguishes evaluated-and-failed, evaluated-and-passed" and "A system that reports silence as approval is not conservative; it is lying by omission". mcp_server/core.py check_measurements sorts every fault into the four states, telling a reader "which faults are present, which are clear, which it could not judge because a number is missing"; a clear fault is a passed test.
